text:
alex: heads-up — main CI went red immediately after merge 0dbf5c3 (https://github.com/redwood-repo/redwood/commit/0dbf5c3). Failing job: image-build-and-deploy (step: upload-artifact). Seeing checksum mismatch + 404 when pulling the artifact.
deploy-bot: [automated] Pipeline failed on main — job image-build-and-deploy — https://ci.redwood.ai/5376
maria: @alex can you paste the failing log snippet? was this the PR that touched build cache prefixes?
alex: sure, log excerpt:
```
[upload-artifact] ERROR: expected checksum a1b2c3 but got d4e5f6
[upload-artifact] ERROR: remote returned 404 for https://artifacts.redwood.ai/store/0dbf5c3/image.tar.gz
```
maria: hmm. sounds like either the upload failed or the artifact path changed. @tj can you try a rerun? or anyone with deploy perms able to force artifact regen?
tj: on it — triggering rerun for the failed job now via /rerun (queued) :hourglass: 
sam: rerun kicked off (job 5378). tagging @oncall-ops in case we need infra to look at the artifact store.
alex: FYI the merged PR modified buildkite pipeline config and switched cache prefix to "build-v2" (PR 3421). if rerun still fails, that config change is my top suspect.
tj: rerun finished — still failing with same checksum mismatch. I'll try a fresh build that bypasses cache and force reupload of the image. Anyone object to a quick revert of the cache-prefix line if this blocks main?
maria: +1 to revert for unblock, we can reintroduce with a migration later.
tj: opened PR to revert the change: https://github.com/redwood-repo/redwood/pull/3428 — assigning self to expedite. cc @alex
deploy-bot: PR 3428 opened by tj — CI will run.
alex: thanks — grabbing eyeballs for the hotpath. :pray:
sam: note: if revert doesn't fix it we should coordinate with infra to list / clear keys under the new prefix in the artifact bucket. pinging infra now.
maria: ack, will loop in infra and post back if they need access.
tj: update — PR 3428 passed CI and I reran image-build-and-deploy manually; upload succeeded and checksum matches. marking resolved for now :white_check_mark:
